title: OpenInbox input
description: Open the inbox at an address, or open it again. The caller becomes its owner. A client sends this after every reconnect, because a restarted service holds no inbox.

inbox.messaging.Adapter.title: Adapter
inbox.messaging.Adapter.description: The wake surface the owner of an inbox reads it through.

inbox.messaging.Address.title: Address
inbox.messaging.Address.description: The address of an inbox: `agent:<host>/<session-name>` or `human:<name>`. `group:<name>` is reserved; version 1 opens no group inbox, and a sender that addresses several inboxes posts one envelope to each under one `thread`.
